conditions: Mention bounded episode and one PTN

permitted_claims.claim: Across the frozen strictly positive relative-RGU grid, Pol ranged from 9.09090909 to 50.00000000.
conditions: Do not call the range a confidence interval or probability distribution

conditions: HUMAN validation and predictive validation are explicitly NOT_PERFORMED

conditions: Do not describe this as independent model consensus

required_qualifiers: The result is not a 15 December 2011 snapshot.
The result is not area-level historical UNO.
The Core UNO field is numerically equal to Pol only because the topology contains one PTN.
RGU and KVPTN are exogenous analytic design parameters, not measured power or objective importance.
The primary coders agreed on 0 of 4 factor entries before targeted review.
The equal-positive baseline is the maximum-Pol point for the verified symmetric opposite positions within the positive RGU ratio family.
The company KVS=5 adjudication is the most fragile released factor.
forbidden_claims: The true polarization of Zhanaozen was 50.
The model predicted the violence or conflict outcome.
The model has been scientifically validated.
Two frontier models independently agreed on the four factor values.
Equal RGU means the actors had equal real-world power.
KVPTN=1 means pay was objectively the most important or equally important issue.
The episode result generalizes to other periods, actors, PTNs or conflicts.
A complete Core status means the historical evidence or constructs are complete.
